subject: Not-identified model with a single indicator

messages.author: 964993c75887caa8
messages.subject: Not-identified model with a single indicator
parts:
Dear all,

This model was identified:

model <- '
# latent variable definitions
#reflective

VIT =~ lossweiw1 + lossappw1
COG =~ failyearw1 + failmonthw1 + faildmonthw1 + faildweekw1
EMO =~ nohappw1 + emptyw1 + nohopew1

'
fit <- cfa(model, data=icopetescsemic, std.lv=TRUE,
ordered=c("lossweiw1","lossappw1",
"failyearw1","failmonthw1","faildmonthw1","faildweekw1","nohappw1","emptyw1","nohopew1"))


Now, when I add a single-indicator with the variance corrected by the
reliability:

model <- '
# latent variable definitions
#reflective

MOB =~ slowstandsw1
VIT =~ lossweiw1 + lossappw1
COG =~ failyearw1 + failmonthw1 + faildmonthw1 + faildweekw1
EMO =~ nohappw1 + emptyw1 + nohopew1

#fix error variance
slowstandsw1 ~~ .11*slowstandsw1
'

fit <- cfa(model, data=icopetescsemic, std.lv=TRUE,
ordered=c("slowstandsw1","lossweiw1","lossappw1","failyearw1","failmonthw1","faildmonthw1","faildweekw1","nohappw1","emptyw1","nohopew1"))




I get this:

Warning messages:

1: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, :

lavaan WARNING:

Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could

not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not

identified.

2: In lav_test_satorra_bentler(lavobject = NULL, lavsamplestats =
lavsamplestats, :

lavaan WARNING: could not invert information matrix needed for
robust test statistic



3: In lav_object_post_check(object) :

lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative



Is there any mistake in my syntax?

Thank you,

Ángel
